Shankar Mandal, aged about 23 years, S/o Kailash Mandal, R/o Village - Sikarposhni, P.O.+P.S. -
Karmatar, District - Jamtara ... ... ... Petitioner Versus The State of Jharkhand ... ...

-------
Coram: Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Arun Kumar Rai
-------
For the Petitioner : Mr. Rahul Ranjan, Advocate For the Opp. Party :Mr. Manoj Kr. Mishra, A.P.P.
------
Order No. 04/Dated 13th September, 2024
1.

The petitioner is praying for grant of bail as he is in custody for allegedly committing offence punishable under Sections 413, 414, 419, 420, 467, 468, 471, 120B of IPC and Sections 66B, 66C,
66D of I.T. Act, in connection with Jamtara Cyber Crime P. S. Case No. 33 of 2024.
2.

entities.text: Jamtara Cyber Crime P. S. Case No. 33 of 2024
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the petitioner has submitted that petitioner is in judicial detention since 20.05.2024 and charge-sheet has already been submitted.

3. Learned counsel also very fairly conceded to the fact that petitioner was involved in one case,
however, he has already been acquitted in that case.

He also pointed out that the similarly situated two of the co-accused persons namely Suraj Mandal and Umesh Mandal have already been admitted to bail by a Co-ordinate Bench of this Court in B.A. No. 6095 of 2024 and B.A. No. 5888 of 2024 respectively, as such, petitioner may be enlarged on bail.
4. Learned Additional Public Prosecutor appearing on behalf of the State conceded to the fact that co-accused persons have already been admitted to bail.

5. Heard learned counsel for both the parties and perused the record.
6.

It transpires that similarly situated two accused persons have been admitted to bail by the Co-ordinate Bench of this court in B.A. No. 6095 of 2024 and B.A. No. 5888 of 2024 respectively,
therefore, this Court finds no reason to take distinct view with respect to the case of the present petitioner.

Jamtara, in connection with Jamtara Cyber Crime P. S. Case No. 33 of 2024.
